`balance_success.json` is a synthetic, redacted fixture based on the official
Alibaba Cloud BSS `QueryAccountBalance` success example. The request ID was
removed and the documented example amount was used as neutral sample data. It
is not a response from a real account and does not validate credentials or
permissions.

Official sources checked on 2026-09-24:

- https://help.aliyun.com/zh/user-center/developer-reference/api-bssopenapi-2017-12-14-queryaccountbalance
- https://help.aliyun.com/zh/actiontrail/developer-reference/request-signatures
